questions.learningObjective: Solve an exam-level problem in discrete mathematics from first principles.
questions.stem: Working from 5, how many binary relations are there on a set with 5 elements? Determine the answer, and state the conclusion.
questions.explanation: A relation is any subset of the n^2 ordered pairs, so there are 2^(5^2)=33554432 relations. Counting functions or subsets of the set gives a much smaller number.
questions.hint: A relation is a subset of the Cartesian product.
